notes_for_editor: Brief status 'relocated' matches tnlandforms 'moved'. The Forest Lookouts list spells the name Summittville Mountain. No dated events exist: build year, staffing and the new site are all missing from the sources. Two web searches found no other lookout on Summitville Mountain; a communications structure in the Summitville community appeared in results and is unrelated. Tennessee Division of Forestry agency rests on the District 5 listing.
